primer: Bloom Energy builds solid-oxide onsite power systems, growing Q3 2026 sales 138% to $1.236 billion. Business quality stays CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL because 9M post-capex cash was $41.6 million (negative ex-tariff refund) beside $5.8 billion in supplier commitments. At $142.39 ($142.45 TradingView), the stock sits far above our $75.98 Base DCF while breaking into Stage 4 below its $150.34 stop. New capital is REJECTED (TIER_0), the 39.795672 held shares trigger EXIT_IMMEDIATELY, and 100% of proceeds stay in cash.
